title: Glass Player
blurb: Bit-perfect music player with a liquid glass UI and parametric EQ.
details: A hi-res audio player for Android built around a bit-perfect output path and a fully glass interface.

title: Signal Lab
blurb: Live audio spectrum and frequency-response visualiser in the browser.
details: Drop in a track or use the mic and watch the spectrum, waveform and phase respond in real time.

title: Amp Notes
blurb: Pocket notebook for IEMs, DACs and amps: gear, measurements, impressions.
details: Keep every piece of audio gear, its measurements and your listening notes in one place.

title: Vibe Kit
blurb: Tiny React toolkit of glass, glow and spring-physics primitives.
details: Open-source primitives for glass surfaces, glow and spring motion in React.

title: dotfiles-zero
blurb: Minimal, fast terminal and editor setup. Clone, run, done.
details: A small dotfiles repo that sets up shell and Neovim in one command.
